primaryMetaphor: Digital Document Transformation - clean container that evolves from empty to filled to emphasized
visualContinuity: Rounded container frame persists and transforms throughout, showing progression from empty → content → emphasis → completion

scenes.name: Title Emergence
scenes.visual: Rounded container materializes at center-top (20% from top, 60% width, centered horizontally). 'TEST TRANSCRIPT' appears with smooth gradient text. Background establishes indigo-purple gradient mood. Clean, professional emergence with spring animation.
scenes.connectsTo: container expands and prepares for content

scenes.name: Content Materialization
scenes.visual: Container expands to center screen (40% from top, 80% width). Text 'This is a test transcript.' types in progressively with each word appearing with subtle bounce. Sky blue accents on key words. Typing effect creates engagement.
scenes.connectsTo: text remains while receiving emphasis treatments

scenes.name: Emphasis & Understanding

keySync.visualEvent: words 'test' and 'transcript' receive highlight glow effects

scenes.visual: Key words 'test' and 'transcript' receive sky blue glow treatment and scale emphasis. Container subtly shifts to show comprehension with color accent borders. Gentle pulsing effects on important concepts draw visual focus.
scenes.connectsTo: emphasized elements settle into completion state

scenes.name: Completion State

keySync.visualEvent: gentle celebration particles emit and final state achieved

scenes.visual: All elements settle into polished final positions. Gentle particle emission from container corners celebrates completion. Clean, professional finish with soft indigo-purple gradient background. Text remains clearly readable in final state.
scenes.buildsFrom: emphasis effects fade to clean completion
